title: The McAlister Special [TMAS]
description: This mod is about inconvenience. A must have for anyone who doesn't feel challenged enough.
body:
### Brief Background

I made this mod back in 2021 as a way to dip my toes into mod making, but I ran into a problem and completely canned the project. Then I rediscovered it and decided to start working on it again. 

### **An update to 1.21.X is in the works**

I'm pretty much redoing it from the ground up (mostly), so updating will take some time seeing as I plan to add more to it.

If you're interested in what's next, I've supplied a to-do list that I'll be updating occassionally at the bottom of this description. :)


# Do You Enjoy Inconvenience?

All mobs that drop leather no longer do that. You have to **_mine_** for it.

![Leather Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b0c1605ba5d607e7efb04335d4c1b0eb7df3b151.png)

**Leather Ore** Veins now generate in caves and mountain faces.
![Leather Ore A Second Time](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5b2a8d76074929776712b93c2ea63ca483b90e6_0.webp)


# Leatherite
- Obtain **Leather** by putting 4 **Leather Fragments** in a crafting table.
![Leather Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a40e69e3c8a4846beee56c348dfb2ec27cb648f.png)

  
- Cook **Leather** in furnace to get a nice treat :)
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/998a0e53fa3a691a911b98d63ddd49c8678d6dce.png)

- You can cook **Leather** in a Furnace, Smoker, and Campfire!
![Cooking Leather In Furnace, Smoker, and Campfire](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07821c961673b562b0f98ec7d36dd21d4ff10b0f.png)

- **Cooked Leather** Can be put back into the furnace to make **Charred Leather**
![Charred Leather Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/58f442e3b690f17ea9bfac28bffb0b9edee19ae0.png)
  
- Put **Charred Leather** into the crafting table to make **Leather Scraps**
![Leather Scrap Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/998d9199810b0273c8c8c90b7c84ddfeb1d06db5.png)

- You can craft **Glue** by combining two **Bones** and two **Bonemeal**. 
![Glue Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5dbd144b899dd0fd72bc46f8649780c7a4ee40f.png)
 
- Make **Gleather** by combining **Leather Scraps** and **Glue**.
 ![Gleather Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d39ae3b3fc91a713c8660bc7defb0be0b9d8b472.png)

- Obtain **Leatherite** by combining **Netherite** and **Gleather** in the Smithing Table!![Leatherite Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f4b96c83173d69917a920b77373722a8da8c4407_0.webp)

# One Final Diabolical Thing

Take a look for yourself.

![Eye of Ender Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ed76617b46ac0bd1a26e944ec13cc8abc2ca5f3.png)

You now need leatherite to make **Eyes of Ender**.

# Good Luck

If it's ~~crossed out~~, it's been added to future update.

If there's an X next to it, some freak accident probably happened preventing me from adding it.
Or, more likely, it was too ambitious. I am still an amatuer, you know.
